      <mri:abstract xsi:type="lan:PT_FreeText_PropertyType">
        <gco:CharacterString>Presented collected with RBRconcertoCTD a set of oceanographic data, including variables: conductivity, temperature, practical salinity, specific density, dissolved oxygen, transmittance, chlorophyll-a, fDOM at sampling rate 8Hz in the Gulf of St. Lawrence at the moorings of SV Oceanolog on the route: Rivière-du-Loup - Gaspe - Magdalen Is. - Cape North. This is a pilot stage's set of high-accuracy and resolution oceanographic data collected during the citizen science project Sail for Science underway to the Caribbean: www.sailforscience.com</gco:CharacterString>

Il s'agit d'un ensemble de données océanographiques de haute précision et de résolution recueillies au cours d'une phase pilote dans le cadre du projet de science citoyenne Sail for Science en cours dans les Caraïbes : www.sailforscience.com</lan:LocalisedCharacterString>

notes: Presented collected with RBRconcertoCTD a set of oceanographic data, including variables: conductivity, temperature, practical salinity, specific density, dissolved oxygen, transmittance, chlorophyll-a, fDOM at sampling rate 8Hz in the Gulf of St. Lawrence at the moorings of SV Oceanolog on the route: Rivière-du-Loup - Gaspe - Magdalen Is. - Cape North. This is a pilot stage's set of high-accuracy and resolution oceanographic data collected during the citizen science project Sail for Science underway to the Caribbean: www.sailforscience.com

CIOOS-Atlantic est un consortium d’institutions partenaires engagées dans le développement de la gestion et la diffusion des données océanographiques de la côte Atlantique, du Labrador à la frontière entre le Maine et le Nouveau-Brunswick.

La collaboration continue avec un large éventail de parties prenantes fait partie intégrante de CIOOS-Atlantique, et nous travaillerons pour répondre aux besoins de la communauté océanographique et veiller à ce que les intérêts régionaux soient représentés au niveau national. L'accent est mis sur la création d'un système qui facilite l'accès aux données afin de soutenir le travail des partenaires, chercheurs, industries, etc.
description_translated.en:
CIOOS-Atlantic is a consortium of partner institutions which are committed to the development of a data management and dissemination approach for oceanographic data from the Atlantic Seaboard, a region spanning from Labrador to the Maine / New Brunswick border.

Meaningful engagement and ongoing communication with a broad variety of stakeholders is an integral component of CIOOS-Atlantic, and we will work to meet the needs of the local oceanographic community and ensure regional interests are represented at the national level. Emphasis is placed on the creation of a system which promotes easy data access and supports the work of partners, researchers, industry, and more.

resources.description: Our mission has two main goals:  1.Collect valuable ocean data sustainably: We gather high-quality oceanographic data using our near-zero-emission sailboat and submit it to global ocean data repositories, where it becomes freely available to scientists worldwide. 2.Empower sailors as citizen scientists: We inspire and engage the global community of cruising sailors to take part in ocean research — demonstrating modern CTD measuring system, teaching how to use them onboard, and showing how every voyage can contribute to real science.
